_what: Import validation and reachability closure re-derived against the artifact on the live alias, not against a local export.
_why_this_file_exists: Another session published v2 and moved the alias while every package-derived conclusion on record still described v1. The IAM verdict, the import validation and the 'nothing reaches razorpay_orders' conclusion had never been measured against the bytes in production.

memberSetDifference.note: customer_session_store.py is present on live and absent from the recorded v1 export; it is NOT in the handler's reachable closure, so it changes no verdict.

iamVerdictScopedToLive.dynamodbConditionCheckItem: implicitDeny, and NOT required - no TransactWriteItems or TransactGetItems anywhere in the live closure
iamVerdictScopedToLive.soTheWithheldGrantIsStillCorrect: secretsmanager:GetSecretValue on wecare/razorpay/api is deliberately NOT granted, and razorpay_orders is unreachable on the live artifact, so the function cannot need it.

secretReadingModules.note: exactly one secret-reading module is reachable (wix_ecom.py), and it is exactly the one secret CheckoutLeastPrivilege grants. The role's single secret grant matches the single reachable reader.
